verdict.rationale: Increase's docs say developers can create virtual and physical cards via the API as soon as they sign up, including unlimited virtual cards that spend funds immediately. They also describe granular authorization control through Real-Time Decision webhooks and 3DS handling, which serves as programmatic spend control. Missing for 10: any evidence of digital wallet (Apple Pay/Google Pay) provisioning, documented built-in spend limits beyond real-time decisioning, explicit documentation of the card-to-account linkage and debit semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
